similar_in_english: give someone a piece of one's mind
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার ভাইকে খুব ডাঁটা দিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He gave his brother a severe scolding.
The teacher scolded the student harshly.
note: The idiom metaphorically refers to physical punishment with a stick, extended to verbal reprimand in Bengali culture.
